nodes.prompt:
TASK: Read-only map the native implementation/test seams for rorca in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite.

DELIVERABLE: Return a concise markdown table naming exact current src-tauri files, symbols, existing tests, and test commands for: product/title/icon config, Ghostty config parsing/terminal options, Tauri command registration, workspace/project registry, Git branch enumeration, and terminal PTY safety. Identify the smallest safe files to change and any integration constraints the implementing worker must preserve.

SCOPE: Read only. Do not edit files, create files, run mutation commands, commit/stash/reset/checkout, or launch the app.

VERIFY: Re-open every cited file and distinguish actual existing code from desired code. Include file:line references.

STOP WHEN: The table gives enough exact targets to implement the native requirements without further codebase discovery.
